title: A PLATE CARRIER, NOT STRIPES
why: His order of 2026-10-12: improve the sprites of all characters, make them all look better, gritty and grounded like ARC Raiders. Every body wore its rig as two dark bands across the coat with a light band over the shoulders, so every coat read as a striped shirt. Now the coat is cloth lit from the top left, the light every sprite shares: the shoulders and the left side catch it and the right side is in shade, the trousers and sleeves too, and each boot has a lit toe. Over the coat sits a real plate carrier: a chest plate in a darker cut of the coat, two shoulder straps, three olive magazine pouches and a belt with a buckle. Curved wears it cut to her outline, the plate moulded over her chest with her pouches on the hips, and her jiggle is kept. Suits and the number 23 jersey keep their own paint.
now: Every pillager, hire, teammate and you now wear a plate carrier with pouches and a belt, and the cloth is lit from one side.
